name: Triggers
integration.summary: Reminders, schedules and watching pages: the team starts on its own
integration.example: Remind me tomorrow at 9 to call the bank
description: Proactivity: schedules, reminders, page watches, webhooks and regular reviews that start background tasks for agents
settings.allowPrivateUrls.title: Allow watching local network addresses
settings.allowPrivateUrls.description: By default watch triggers do not access localhost and internal addresses (SSRF protection)
settings.watchTimeoutSec.title: Page load timeout, seconds
notify.nowReports.title: {n, plural, one {This schedule now sends its report as a message} other {These schedules now send their report as a message}}
notify.nowReports.body: {names}: {n, plural, one {at its time it now sends} other {at its time each one now sends}} you what it found as a message of its own. {n, plural, one {If you'd rather it stayed} other {If you'd rather one of them stayed}} a quiet check that speaks up only when something needs you, tell me in the chat, for example: “make {example} a quiet check again”.
notify.nowReports.name: “{name}”
error.tooLong: Field {field} is too long (at most {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}})
error.badUrl: Invalid address "{url}": a full URL is required, e.g. https://example.com/page
error.httpOnly: Only http and https addresses are supported
error.intervalNumber: intervalMinutes must be a number of minutes
error.intervalMin: The check interval must be at least {min, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} (got {value})
error.intervalMax: The check interval must be at most a week ({max, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}})
error.timesList: times must be a non-empty list of "HH:MM" times, e.g. ["10:00", "18:00"]
error.timeFormat: Time "{value}" must be in HH:MM format, e.g. "09:30"
error.weekdaysList: weekdays must be a non-empty list of weekdays 0–6 (0 = Sunday)
error.maxRuns: maxRunsPerDay must be an integer from 1 to 1000
error.badTime: Cannot understand the time "{value}": use ISO format, e.g. 2026-10-27T09:00 (your local time) or 2026-10-27T06:00:00Z
error.selectorOrJsonPath: Specify only one: selector (for HTML) or jsonPath (for JSON)
error.kindFixed: The trigger kind cannot be changed: create a new trigger instead
error.enabledBool: enabled must be true or false
error.reportBool: report must be true or false
error.reportKind: Only schedules and one-time triggers can be reports: other kinds speak up only when something needs attention
error.onceFired: This one-time trigger has already fired: set a new time (at)
error.cronMissing: Specify a 5-field cron (minute hour day month weekday), e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5"
error.cronFields: Invalid cron expression "{expr}": exactly 5 fields are required (minute hour day month weekday), e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5"
error.notJson: The response is not JSON, so the JSON path cannot be applied
error.selectorNothing: CSS selector {selector} found nothing on the page
error.privateHost: The address {host} is on the internal network: watching it is not allowed (allowPrivateUrls setting)
error.previousRunning: The previous run has not finished yet
error.machineGone: The computer "{machine}" is no longer connected to the hub
error.checkWatchOnly: Only a watch trigger can be checked now
ui.title: Triggers
ui.subtitle: When the agent should act on its own. Time zone: {tz}
ui.empty.title: No triggers yet
ui.empty.hint: Create a schedule, a reminder or a page watch, or ask the assistant in the chat.
ui.kindHint.schedule: Repeats on a cron schedule in your time zone.
ui.kindHint.once: Fires once at the given time, like a reminder.
ui.kindHint.watch: Checks a page or JSON and starts the agent only when the value changes.
ui.kindHint.event: Gives you a webhook URL with a secret: an external service sends an event and the agent handles it.
ui.kindHint.heartbeat: A regular review: the agent looks through memory, tasks and upcoming plans and writes only if something matters.
ui.form.name: Name
ui.form.promptPlaceholder: For example: check my mail and tell me if anything is urgent
ui.form.promptHint: The event context (the change, webhook data) is added automatically.
ui.form.machineHint: For work that needs this computer's files, apps or hardware.
ui.form.cronHint: minute hour day month weekday, time zone {tz}. “0 9 * * 1-5” means weekdays at 9:00.
ui.form.intervalHint: At least 5 minutes. The agent starts only when something changes.
ui.form.eventHint: The webhook URL and secret appear after the trigger is created.
ui.history.title: History: {name}
ui.card.changed: Something changed: the agent is started
